Plex currently needs atlas (it runs as a Docker container there) and tank (library on tank/media, appdata on tank/appdata). The titan dependency is superseded history.

If titan is off, the Ollama endpoint on titan stops (direct dependency, needs titan awake). The wiki search service on hermes degrades (second hop): new wiki pages are not embedded, but keyword search still works.
The nightly rclone backup needs atlas (it runs as a job there), tank (it reads the 05:45 tank snapshot), and gate (for internet access to upload to the cloud remote).
The hermes VM needs atlas (it runs on atlas and stops when atlas stops) and tank (its vdisk is on tank/domains; it cannot boot without tank).

If atlas stops, the Syncthing sync of notes to pebble stops. Syncthing runs as a container on atlas (direct), and its sync to pebble runs only over Tailscale, which is also on atlas (second hop); tank, which holds the notes share, also goes down with atlas.

If gate goes down, direct losses: aria (network features), the Tailscale plugin (no internet, so remote access fails), the nightly rclone backup (no upload), and the reverse proxy's outside access on 443; atlas only loses email notifications. Second hop via Tailscale: pebble's remote access and Syncthing's sync to pebble.

Directly it needs hermes (it runs there next to the wiki repo). Indirectly, hermes needs atlas and tank (hermes is a VM on atlas with its vdisk on tank), and atlas needs apc-1 for power. The titan Ollama endpoint is needed only for embeddings, not keyword search.

If atlas shuts down, the ZFS pool tank and the hermes VM stop with it. Direct atlas services that stop: Plex, the Caddy reverse proxy, Syncthing, the Tailscale plugin, and the nightly rclone backup. Second hop: the wiki search service (on hermes) and pebble's Tailscale remote access, plus Syncthing to pebble.

If tank is unavailable while atlas runs, the hermes VM cannot boot, Plex loses its library and appdata, Syncthing stops syncing the notes share, and the nightly rclone backup has no snapshot to upload. Second hop: the wiki search service on hermes stops, and the reverse proxy's Plex and wiki search fronting then has nothing to serve.

If hermes is down, the wiki search service (qmd) directly stops working, and its nightly index rebuild does not run so the index goes stale. Its Caddy front on 443 then has no working backend. The wiki repo at /srv/wiki is also unavailable, and pebble loses remote access to hermes.
